These five records were extracted verbatim from the installed EverQuest Legends
`eqstr_us.txt`. The complete source file's SHA-256 is
`DC721F795A0C47DD5621FBC69DF83FE25436ADD036D8D6D0F7EF890C2B8C2157`.

The companion fixture is a client string table excerpt, **not a recorded gameplay
log**. Assignment and update messages also appear in committed gameplay fixtures.
The completed, removed and failed templates establish the exact message text but
their emission into a player's log has not yet been observed. Tests substitute
a task name into `%1` and add an EQ timestamp explicitly as a synthetic boundary
test; they do not claim that a player completed or failed that task.
